verdict.rationale: Manufact's changelog mentions a public MCP catalog at manufact.com/mcp-catalog where users can browse public checklist scores. That is a first-party, browsable listing of MCP servers, but it is framed around readiness scores, not capability discovery. Missing for 10: search functionality, filtering or browsing by capability, evidence the catalog is large, tool-level listings, and catalog documentation or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search and browse a large catalog of MCP servers and tools by capability before wiring anything into my agent

citations.quote: browse public checklist scores at manufact.com/mcp-catalog
